mechanism_narrative: The sustained four-week decline in RETAIL_REC mobility indicates a persistent trend of reduced public engagement with retail and recreation venues, which will continue to drive down mobility in this category over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than or equal to the mean of the last 28 days, despite the observed downward trend.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL mobility continues its upward trend and exceeds 29.0 percent change from baseline, it signals an intensified stay-at-home behavior that will further suppress out-of-home activities, including retail and recreation, over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility rises above 29.0, but RETAIL_REC mobility does not decline further over the subsequent two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The concurrent and sustained decline in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility indicates a significant reduction in daily commuting and associated foot traffic, which will collectively depress RETAIL_REC mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility both decline, but RETAIL_REC mobility stabilizes or increases over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of increasing public caution, the observed decline in PARKS mobility, reflecting reduced outdoor leisure, will precede and contribute to a further decline in RETAIL_REC mobility over the next week, as people limit all non-essential outings.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility continues to decline in a tightening restrictions regime, but RETAIL_REC mobility improves over the subsequent week.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent four-week decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, suggesting a reduction even in essential trips, indicates a broader behavioral shift towards staying home that will further reduce RETAIL_REC mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM mobility continues its decline, but RETAIL_REC mobility does not decline further over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week drop in TRANSIT mobility exceeding 1.0 percentage point signifies a sharp reduction in public transport usage, directly leading to fewer people accessing retail and recreation venues and thus a decline in RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 1.0 point week-on-week
failure_condition: TRANSIT mobility falls by more than 1.0 point week-on-week, but RETAIL_REC mobility does not decline further over the subsequent two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility continues to rise while WORKPLACES mobility remains stagnant or declines, it indicates a reinforcing cycle of prolonged stay-at-home behavior without a return to work, which will further suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility rises and WORKPLACES mobility declines, but RETAIL_REC mobility improves over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a deeply suppressed mobility environment, where all categories are significantly below baseline, any further decline in PARKS mobility signals a complete withdrawal from non-essential outdoor activities, reinforcing the downward trend in RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: PARKS mobility declines further in a deeply suppressed environment, but RETAIL_REC mobility stabilizes or increases over the subsequent week.
